# Invoicing workflow

How I bill freelance clients, from timesheet to paid invoice.

1. At the end of the month export the hours from the time tracker.
2. Create the invoice in the accounting app, numbering is `YYYY-NNN`.
3. Attach the timesheet as a PDF and send the invoice from the shared mailbox.
4. Payment terms are 14 days. Add a reminder on day 15.
5. When the payment arrives, match it to the invoice and mark it paid.

Foreign clients get the invoice in English with the reverse charge note. Keep a copy of every invoice for ten years.
